description: Ensure Create Account is a distinct usable registration workflow rather than an immediate sign-in redirect.
steps: Open the signed-out home page and select Create account
Verify the current sign-in method remains provider-managed; no nonfunctional password field is shown.
Verify the manual registration form is visible and empty name/email produces inline validation errors
Enter a valid full name, email, campus ID and Student role; click Verify email & create account
Choose the email provider and complete its passwordless verification
Return to the app and confirm your Student profile is created, then reload to check persistence
Register a different new verified account as Faculty; verify that it immediately enters Faculty workspace without pending approval.
Sign in via Google as a new account. Ensure the profile does not open dashboard before selecting Student or Faculty; public Administrator role must not appear.

As a non-admin, attempt admin invite API and confirm forbidden. As original admin, invite a verified email, sign in with that exact email and verify approved admin access; revoke invite and verify access is blocked.

As student, attempt delete without typing DELETE and verify rejection. Confirm DELETE disables profile and returns to signed-out view; re-sign-in cannot restore a deleted profile. Academic records persist. Administrator cannot self-delete.
Confirm Sign in offers only supported Google/Apple/passwordless email providers, no simulated password field.

Inspect signup and post-Google onboarding: public choices are Student or Faculty only; user must tap one before entering dashboard; the original administrator account is recognized from verified server authorization.
In Settings choose Light and Dark; reload and confirm persisted appearance across panels, forms, landing page, modal and profile ID; Switch to Faculty workspace is absent.
In Administrator view invite a verified email, verify invite state, then revoke it; non-admin must not be able to open or invoke this workflow.
Open Delete Account: action is disabled until DELETE is entered. After confirmation sign out; deleted account cannot reopen campus records. Admin sees a protection message.
On iPhone/Android landscape 812×375, open menu. Confirm two-column scrollable navigation reveals all destinations including Settings and Sign out; the dock does not obscure content.
Invite an existing Faculty account, sign in as the invited administrator, revoke that invitation as primary administrator, verify admin access is immediately denied and Faculty role is restored.
On student/faculty mobile portrait, swipe LEFT from the right edge to open the menu; swipe RIGHT to close. Verify weekly schedule swipes do not open it.
In landscape 812x375 and 920x430, ensure nav dock is on RIGHT; drawer has one scrollable vertical column without visible scrollbar; all destinations accessible and content not zoomed.
On profile page, tap card to flip; instructions are visible; select a large image and adjust zoom and position before saving. Confirm card portrait and topbar avatar use the saved cropped image.
Tap an unread notification to open its full text/date and related-page button. Check read state after closing.
Switch light/dark themes and open digital excuse letters: check background, heading, body, badge contrast, and overlapping shapes.
As admin, use only user/admin invitations, account role approvals, technical reports and audit. Attempt obsolete /api/admin/section and /api/admin/import/commit and verify they are unavailable.
Submit a technical issue in Settings as Student/Faculty; verify it appears in the admin issue list and can be resolved; offline devices absent from reports must not be marked healthy.
expected: A valid Student or Faculty selection activates the corresponding workspace after sign-in; Administrator access remains email-allowlist restricted.

description: Regression-checks the established academic workflows after dashboard redesign.
steps: From Student Overview, tap Scan class QR once; confirm camera opens automatically and no QR-token textbox or manual submit button exists.
Point the camera at a valid faculty QR and confirm attendance automatically records without another click.
Open Profile: verify current photo/email/role/ID, change name, department and bio, upload a photo and confirm updates persist after reload.
As approved Faculty, open an assigned QR session and display a signed code
As enrolled Student, scan the signed QR on a phone-sized viewport; on Safari use the JavaScript camera scanner fallback
Review attendance and generate CSV from authorized records
Submit a future-dated excuse and a consultation request
As Faculty, review the respective pending decisions
As Faculty, click Open calendar; choose multiple future dates directly in the month grid, configure hours and capacity, and publish them in a single action.
Try to publish a slot overlapping your scheduled MW or TTH class; verify the system rejects it and shows a helpful error.
Cancel a future slot with pending/confirmed bookings and verify booking statuses and notifications update.
Attempt to publish a Sunday consultation slot colliding with a Sunday A class. Confirm server rejects overlap.
As Student, go to Classes > Export calendar; open downloaded .ics in an iCalendar viewer and verify Sunday entries use RRULE BYDAY=SU.
Verify Student/Faulty seven-day class timetable matches MW and TTH recurrences and displays Sunday classes.
Book a future consultation, then cancel it as the requesting Student and confirm Faculty is notified.
Confirm a booking, cancel it as Student, then ensure the slot's remaining seat count is restored and another Student may request it.
Update Student year level and phone; update Faculty office room; refresh and confirm private profile details persist.
Switch between compact, comfortable and spacious density and reload to verify the preference is retained.
Disconnect a Student browser, scan live QR, and verify a ciphertext-only IndexedDB entry with a preserved capturedAt timestamp.
Reload offline and verify the queued scan remains visible; reconnect and check automatic 15-second synchronization.
Simulate invalid signature and >12-hour queue expiry; confirm these remain Needs attention rather than disappearing.
Test different Student accounts on the same browser; verify a Student sees only their own queue.
In Student Profile → Preferences, export the active ClassPulse schedule and confirm the .ics has 15-minute VALARM and Sunday A classes use BYDAY=SU.
Verify native Android reminder project is a separate build, and the website does not claim guaranteed background alarms.
Open Schedule, use weekday buttons, keyboard arrows and mobile swipe to browse all seven stacked class cards without side arrows. Validate Sunday A entries.
Open Student QR scanner and verify the capture guidance appears outside camera view; open notifications and check compact text.
Try submitting an empty consultation topic or an excuse reason under 8 characters. The Save/Submit action should stay disabled until valid.
Export Student Records CSV with a name beginning with = or + and verify it is escaped as literal text in a spreadsheet.

Sign in as Student, open My Profile: the front of a ClassPulse digital campus card shows current profile photo, name, role, ID and college. Flip to Details and back using buttons; check it cannot be mistaken for an official university-issued identity card.
Change portrait, save, refresh and verify card displays the saved image. Copy campus identifier only if one exists.
Repeat ID card interaction for Faculty and Administrator, verifying role-specific office/year/access details.
Check 360px mobile viewport and reduced motion setting: card fits, readable details and accessible card-side selectors.
Visit Classes → My class week and verify no previous/next side arrow buttons exist; swipe the schedule left and right on phone/tablet. Day indicator and classes must follow the visible snap card.
Use desktop trackpad horizontal scroll or drag, and select day pills. Press arrow keys/Home/End when the card deck is focused. Use Return to Today after selecting another day.
Check that A is labeled Sunday and that existing MW/TTH/F/S recurring classes appear only on their intended weekdays.
On Classes → My class week, verify the two cards visible beneath the top one are actual neighboring weekdays with their own subject information, not flat decorative backing plates.
Touch-drag the top day card to the left across at least 65 px: it should follow the finger, reveal the next populated weekday underneath, fly off, and promote the next card to the top.
Touch-drag the card to the right to reveal the preceding day, and swipe less than 65 px to confirm it snaps back to the original day.
On desktop drag with the mouse; test Left/Right/Home/End keyboard navigation and weekday tabs without arrow buttons.
Verify academic date codes MW TTH F S A (A = Sunday), reduced-motion accessibility, and unchanged actual subject records.
Confirm lightweight hover and press feedback on consultation cards and action buttons without excessive animation.

On Attendance, queue an offline QR, verify the Sync center displays pending capture and the 12-hour remaining time, reconnect, and use Sync now. Beyond 12 hours the UI must display Needs review without auto-accepting.
On Consultations, swipe future faculty-published slot cards, request an available one, and check the request appears in the history; full slots are disabled and faculty cancellation still works.
On Notifications, filter by unread, class, attendance, and requests using real notice kinds, open an unread entry, and use Mark all read to verify server-persisted read state.
In Classes, confirm Today Focus identifies only actual scheduled courses, local Manila time and an accurate empty state, then tap View week to scroll to My class week.
At mobile and desktop widths, confirm the stacked cards never cover or intercept weekday tabs, even when many subjects appear on one day.
Tap a top-card class row to reveal its details; close the panel and verify swiping, tapping and vertical scrolling continue to work.
In Profile tap the academic card and press Enter/Space while focused to flip its sides; preserve the not-an-official-ID disclaimer.
Confirm Overview has no Quick Actions and Classes has no Favorite Cards section.
On a narrow screen, navigate using the smaller five-item floating dock with accessible labels.
Seed multiple excuses in two months as Student and Faculty, expand folders and individual documents, review an attachment and approve or reject an existing pending excuse.
Swipe seven weekly cards, select weekdays, view an expanded subject and confirm the controls never overlap the cards; verify Sunday A scheduling and active calendar dates.
Verify a cached QR scan syncs only during the 12-hour grace period and suspicious timestamps still require review.

Student: open Classes, tap a subject code in the table and a class inside the weekly card. The selected details show professor, room, section, enrolled count, safe classmate names and the signed-in student’s own attendance summary.

Verify Present, Late, Absent and Excused counts only use finalized verification statuses; latest pending scan remains pending instead of being falsely counted as verified. No faculty-generated QR session must not create an absence.
Faculty: expand an assigned subject, view enrollment names and use View full roster to open existing Student Records; no My Attendance panel should appear for faculty.
Student A must not be able to request GET /api/sections/:id/details for a class joined only by Student B; an Administrator must not receive roster identities from this endpoint.
Verify subject detail buttons on the Overview subject rows route to Classes with that subject expanded; collapse/expand uses keyboard and works at mobile viewport.
On 320px, 375px, 430px iOS and Android smartphone viewports, open Classes, select a subject, inspect full details and check every course field fits without sideways scrolling.
Review a populated Attendance table on phone; each record must show all status fields as a vertical card with no horizontal scrolling.

Open Digital Excuses with seven records and confirm a vertical stack of paper-like excuse letters, four visible by default, expand for full written letter, Show more to reveal the rest and review faculty decisions and attachments.

In Weekly Schedule swipe left to reveal the NEXT front-stacked day; swipe right to bring the PREVIOUS day forward. The next-day cards should be centered behind the active card, not spread to the right.
Flip the profile card to Details on iOS Safari and Android Chrome; the back is fully opaque, legible, not transparent, and only the selected face exists in the DOM.
On Attendance student view there is exactly one Scan QR action; Overview no Full schedule link and header no logout; account sign-out remains accessible through Settings.
Check consultation slots, notification filters and class reports at 375px and 768px without sideways scrolling of primary information.
Open Classes and select a subject: class-week cards and other subject summaries should disappear; only the selected expanded class details are visible until Close.
On the weekly schedule, tap one class: the card deck is replaced with the expanded subject information; closing restores the weekday deck without leaving a duplicate summary.

Swipe the class-week top card LEFT: it peels forward revealing the next day. Swipe RIGHT: the previous day slides from the left onto the front while the current card recedes. Verify weekday tabs and arrow keys still work.
Toggle the profile ID between front and back on iOS Safari and Android Chrome. Both solid sides show an actual 3D rotation, with no transparent overlap or mirrored text.
Expand several submitted excuse letters and verify there are no extra long bars or overlapping shapes beneath them; open attachments and Review remain functional.
Open Student Attendance: verify the decorative dimensional QR illustration is separate from the single Scan QR button, which still launches the camera.
Enable Reduce Motion and repeat week swipes, ID flip, and excuse expansion; functionality remains available without decorative animation.
Submit a Monday/Wednesday subject excuse dated Tuesday directly to POST /api/excuses: 422. Submit on Monday or Wednesday with enrollment: accepted.
Create MW subject excuse: only Monday/Wednesday dates clickable on current, past and next month; changing subject clears selection; direct Tuesday submission to backend rejected.
Open several excuse letters in Light and Dark modes, verify body text and student sender visible and no overlapping shapes/icons or native date-field overdraw.
Regression: scan QR online and offline as an enrolled student, verify 12-hour cached token checks and faculty review remain unchanged; admin cannot call academic section endpoints.
expected: Attendance records and academic requests remain account-bound, persistent, and subject to faculty verification and decisions.
